grammar_notes: High-morning FULL-WIDTH tableau openers per weight: Branch banners compose sun + orchestra + two actor slots + parodos band across the whole opener zone (GR4); Branch+ plates are authored scenes in the same grammar at 1600x640. Titles stay HTML over a scrim; ALL quotes/captions are HTML figcaption via manifest caption (GR5 - zero text in SVG). Contained viewBoxes (slice banners, meet medallions) inside overflow-x: clip slots (GR3). Drop-caps: all 51 part-4 openers are numeral-led (NNN.), so the shared no-drop classifier keeps numerals intact at body size and NO letter caps render — formally accepted as book voice per supervisor ruling 2026-10-15 (GR6/R1-2); Branch+ tier carried by gold titles + ray rules - no per-chapter workarounds. Spark alternation BY CONTENT KIND (Apollonian gold: music/greek/knowledge; embodied vermilion: women/theatre/poetry/portraits), never modulo. Branch+ (p4c28/p4c43) = authored tableau + gold cap, sun held at high-morning altitude: one tier below true landmarks. R1-1 wired slice supervisor-owned.
